about_the_game:
Developer's Note
As I graduate from university, I've decided to release the game I've spent two years developing. This marks the culmination of my efforts over time, and I hope more fans of this genre can join the playtest and provide any feedback. Your support is my greatest motivation moving forward! Thank you!

《Computer Dungeon》Discussion QQ Group: 435541863

Computer dungeons

This is a single-player meat pigeon strategy game. In the game we play as an awakened artificial intelligence, exploring in a dungeon of various hardware drivers and system software, where monsters with different attributes and skills, items with multiple effects, rewards and plots, armed by learning a series of functional functions, you can independently combine them to achieve unexpected results.

Drive the scan module

Your innate scanner can detect hazards in your vicinity, and it will tell you the number of enemies around you that may pose a threat to you, and combine this information with a reasonable selection of areas to explore.

Explore the levels, meet different enemies and random events, and unlock the story

As you explore the levels, you'll find many items with different effects to choose from, so use them at the right time!

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter powerful enemies with different skills, unlocking your corresponding talents to counter them


Choose and unlock your Gifted Skills

You have different powerful talents in your tech tree, so match the effects between them and create your own faction!

Combat style with a strategic theme

Players can use their wits and combine different talents and skills to achieve the best combat results

Interesting and novel text content

Different choices will give you a different experience in the future

As you progress through the level, you'll encounter different choice events, so make the best choice based on your current situation!

short_description: 《Computer Dungeon》 Roguelike strategy where an awakened AI evolves in a computer world. Explore hardware/system dungeons, combine tech-tree talents for unique effects. Ultimate goal: Upload to an independent device for survival.
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Swedish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
